description: Machine format (wr.telemetry.v1, testnet): the latest sealed compile envelope per telemetry metric; optional metric filter. Use telemetry_series instead for every envelope of one metric over time. The latest point per metric is chosen by its as_of timestamp; stale_flags lists metrics whose newest point the store marks stale. If the store file is absent on this deployment, latest is empty with a note. Returns {format, latest, stale_flags}. Behaviour: read-only and public — no authentication; every call is logged in aggregate (tool name, query, result count, coarse client class; no IP addresses).

metric.description: Metric id, as enumerated by this tool when metric is omitted; omit for the latest envelope of every metric.

name: telemetry_latest
title: Latest Telemetry (Machine Format)
